merchantDashboard.title: Klump Access via Merchant Dashboard
description: Every API request to Klump's endpoints must include an API key, specifically the Klump secret key. If you do not include an API key with your request, or if you use an incorrect or outdated key, Klump will reject it and return an error.

To use Klump Access, log into your merchant dashboard and select the Klump Access menu on the navigation bar - make sure to change your environment to LIVE, or else every page you create in your test environment will only work for test transactions - and create a page.

Enter a title for the page, a description for the page, and an image and amount to create a Klump Access page. There are two types of amount options: fixed and free-flowing. The fixed amount requires your customer to pay a set amount, whereas the free-flowing amount allows your customer to pay whatever amount they want.
To deactivate a payment page, click the visibility button on the payment page details page.

api.title: Klump Access via API
description: If you have an app, you can use an API to generate a Klump Access page for your users. This is useful if you want to offer the BNPL option to your customers without integrating through the Klump JS or using one of the provided plugins and libraries.

You can optionally supply a reference (merchant_reference) for each payment page. This value is stored on transactions and returned in webhooks and API responses. Supplying a unique reference per page is recommended, especially for fixed-amount pages, so you can match payments to the correct order.
In the case where the is_fixed_amount is true, you will be required to give an amount not less than N25,000.

example.code:
curl --location --request POST 'https://api.useklump.com/v1/payment-pages' \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --header 'klump-secret-key: {{KLUMP_SEC_KEY}}' \
    -d '{
  "name": "Jerande's 30th Birthday",
  "description": "This is a great opportunity to let your hair down.",
  "currency": "NGN",
  "is_fixed_amount": false,
  "reference": "BRD2025001",
  "is_published": true
}'

example2.code:
curl --location --request POST 'https://api.useklump.com/v1/payment-pages' \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --header 'klump-secret-key: {{KLUMP_SEC_KEY}}' \
    -d '{
  "name": "Jerande's 30th Birthday",
  "description": "This is a great opportunity to let your hair down.",
  "currency": "NGN",
  "is_fixed_amount": true,
  "fixed_amount": 30000,
  "reference": "BRD2025JER01",
  "is_published": true
}'
